title: ORBIT: annotation-aware empirical enrichment and semantic reranking for interpretable functional-class recovery.
snippet: To address the long, redundant result tables produced by standard gene-set enrichment tools, we developed the Ontology-Ranked Biological Interpretation Tool (ORBIT), which combines annotation-aware empirical enrichment, semantic reranking, and representative-term selection to generate compact functional summaries linked to supporting genes. title: Marker-based CRISPR screens identify POU2F1 as a regulator of DLL3 and neuroendocrine identity in small cell lung cancer.
snippet: Small cell lung cancers (SCLCs) often exhibit a neuroendocrine lineage identity marked by high expression of Delta-like ligand 3 (DLL3). Because DLL3 shows minimal expression in normal adult tissues, it serves as an SCLC-selective tumor antigen and is the basis for clinically efficacious targeted therapies.
